QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] We Have the Technology
QuestInfo.0: #bPhoebe#k says there's a way to save #bSpencer#k from dying. Talk with her and listen to her plan.
QuestInfo.1: #bPhoebe#k says she needs lots of machine parts to save #bSpencer#k. You need to head to the Forest Near the Hideout, defeat the machines roaming there, and bring back anything that looks like it might be useful.
QuestInfo.2: You've gathered all the parts needed to save \n#bSpencer#k and brought them to #bPhoebe#k. But even after all of Phoebe's best efforts, they may not be enough.

item.0: You'll need a lot of #b#i4036644# #t4036644##k and #b#i4036645# #t4036645##k items to save Spencer!\r\nHead to the nearby forest!
